rows.ethical_framing: # edge-io-measurement-node Ring / Edge I/O **sensing and measurement** stack for gunnchOS3k — privacy-first telemetry, firmware paths, and Lab-facing contracts. > **Current release/state:** `PHYSICAL_PENDING` — digital pipelines + synthetic smoke exist; absolute spatial accuracy on hardware is pending. Ecosystem portal: [gunnchos-research-portal](https://github.com/gunnchOS3k/gunnchos-research-portal) · Product chart
Schemas, probes, firmware/research paths, and opt-in telemetry for Edge I/O Rings and related measurement nodes.
Embodied input and honest network/experience metrics need a dedicated measurement layer with consent and claim discipline.
Product Charter **layer 7** (Ring sensing/measurement). Consumed by `gunnchos-device-os` Ring/input paths.

- Schema-validated synthetic / smoke telemetry (`make smoke` / `make e2e`) - Privacy helpers and 7GC/Lab export contracts - Firmware and gate1 digital fabrication *research* artifacts as documented in-tree
- Synthetic measurement batches and emulator-style probes - Spatial accuracy labelled SIMULATED until physical calibration

methods: # Reproducibility — Edge-IO Measurement Node (RQ3) This repository’s default path is **digital**: simulated device, consent, telemetry schema, privacy sanitization, anti-replay counters, and research export. It does **not** contain executed Pixel 6a field measurements in git. Absolute spatial accuracy remains **PHYSICAL_PENDING**. IMU (ring classifier) is **relative cues only**, not validated absolute pose. No University of Oulu affiliation is claimed. ## Clone / setup / run ```bash git clone https://github.com/gunnchOS3k/edge-io-measurement-node.git cd edge-io-measurement-node python3 -m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt make test make smoke # long e2e; sy
